meta_title: Marketing Subscription Service for UK Small Businesses
meta_description: A marketing subscription gives UK small businesses social, SEO, content and web help for a fixed monthly fee. Compare plans from £59/mo.

faq.q: What is a marketing subscription service?
faq.a: A fixed monthly plan that includes a set amount of marketing work, such as posts, videos, SEO or website changes.

faq.q: How much is a marketing subscription in the UK?
faq.a: From about £59 a month for one channel to £389 a month for a full team with ContentFellow. Agency subscriptions often cost £500–£2,000 a month.

faq.q: Can I cancel a marketing subscription?
faq.a: Usually yes, on notice. ContentFellow plans are monthly with no long contract.

faq.q: Is a subscription better than hiring an agency?
faq.a: For most small businesses, yes: costs are predictable and you can start small.
